items.title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot
items.summary: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. items.summary: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design.
